name: Pacific 4-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna
description: Description Imagine stepping into your backyard and finding a warm, glowing sanctuary waiting for you and the people you love. A space where the air is calm, the lighting softens your senses, and the world slows down as deep infrared heat eases tension from the inside out. This is how evenings shift, how weekends feel different, and how your home becomes a destination for restoration—not just for you, but for your entire circle. The Pacific 4-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna transforms an ordinary deck or patio into a year-round wellness retreat. With seating designed for shared relaxation, clean infrared heat that rises to ~140°F, and craftsmanship rooted in solid Canadian Hemlock, it becomes more than an upgrade—it's a lifestyle shift. A reliable, weather-ready ritual space that supports your well-being day after day. And why do you think infrared therapy has become a cornerstone for recovery experts, health-focused homeowners, and high performers? Because when the heat is consistent, the environment is inviting, and the experience is effortless, the practice sticks. It becomes a habit of grounding, a ritual of clarity, a moment where your body renews itself every time you step inside. This isn’t a casual purchase. It’s a long-term investment that reshapes the rhythm of your home—expanding your outdoor living experience, supporting your health goals, and offering years of comfort with a weather-sealed, professionally certified design. The cost fades, but the daily sanctuary remains. Picture yourself a few weeks from now: stepping into the warm cedar-toned interior, the chromatherapy lighting casting a calming hue, a playlist humming gently through the Bluetooth sound system, and the reassuring sense that you’ve created a space that nurtures both mind and body. This is the new normal your home was ready for. Features Painted & sealed weatherproof finish for reliable indoor or outdoor use—beautiful, durable, and engineered for all seasons. Modern metal composite roof offering long-lasting protection against the elements while maintaining a sleek architectural aesthetic. Solid Canadian Hemlock construction for natural beauty, structural strength, and a spa-quality feel. Far infrared heating system that warms quickly to ~140°F, supporting deep muscle relaxation and whole-body rejuvenation. Wide bench seating to comfortably accommodate up to four people—ideal for families, couples, or wellness gatherings. Interior & exterior LED lighting for ambiance, visibility, and a refined evening presence in your outdoor space. Color-changing chromatherapy lighting that enhances mood and elevates each session into a multisensory ritual. Digital control panel for simple, reliable temperature and lighting adjustments. Bluetooth sound system to enjoy music, meditations, or ambient soundscapes during sessions. Air purification system ensuring fresh, clean air for the duration of every sauna experience. Cup holders and thoughtful functional details for comfort and convenience. 4800-watt power system delivering strong, consistent infrared output for a highly effective session. ETL/CSA certified electrical components for safety, reliability, and peace of mind. What’s Included?
